correctness.rationale: Gap positions 2^j-1 give unique gaps 2^j and exact one-pair padding caps. Each proposed forbidden word has occurring maximal proper factors. Every word avoiding them has power-of-two internal gaps, forced doubling across triples, and admissible boundary padding, giving a unique source occurrence. The disjoint length census follows. verify.py returned VERIFY_OK at 40 lengths and direct all-word tests through length 12; finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The minimal forbidden-factor basis for a natural sparse automatic word is an infinite structural classification, unlike a finite computed list: all but one obstructions have exactly two ones, and the precise number by length is uniformly at most three with lacunary spikes. It supplies a compact exact language-membership criterion and a computable antidictionary, connecting explicit automatic words to forbidden-pattern compression.
